METHOD CORRECTION (supersedes nothing, ADDS to last night's): parent-child edge DIRECTION. In `.beads/issues.jsonl` a dependency row lives ONLY on the dependent/child record, and within it `issue_id` == the owning bead, `depends_on_id` == the OTHER end. Verified: 0 rows where issue_id != owning bead id; the parent record carries an empty `dependencies` array. So for a parent-child edge the PARENT is `depends_on_id`, NOT `issue_id`. Getting this backwards inflates I1 from 50 to 116 (it silently tests 'does this bead have an edge naming itself'). Caught by a cross-check: bd-f2wc0 appeared BOTH as a child of epic bd-vbmre and as an I1 orphan — a contradiction that can only mean a parse bug. Always cross-check the I1 set against the epic child roll-up; they must be disjoint.

Also note `$epicList | INDEX(.)` then `select($epic[.parent] != null)` is correct, but writing `$epics|index(.a)` inside a pipe is NOT — `.` there is the array, so `.a` indexes an array with a string and jq errors 'Cannot index array with string'. Bind endpoints to variables or use an INDEX object.
